mapper.sql: CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,s.code,s.name,s.contact_name,s.contact_phone,s.address,s.enabled,s.remark,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order p WHERE p.supplier_id=s.id) purchase_count,s.created_at

where.if: AND (CONVERT(s.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM supplier s ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM supplier s WHERE s.id=#{id}
